status_before_prospective_freeze: Prepared protocol; do not launch before development serving pilot review
fanout_selection: First two frozen source IDs per family, selected before any heldout generation
witness_logprob_deduplication: Margin-benefit requests LPs for only the first genuine raw business request per namespace/query in a wave. The second tenant still receives its real raw answer, full prompt/output IDs and hashes. Legacy logging/request behavior is preserved. No extra raw generation is introduced.
before_test_known_negative_constraint: Profile-only v1 optimum was amended before any new heldout generation: raw floor must strictly exceed the 0.03125 full raw-reference minimum of the already observed Mistral paired-tenant failure. V1 pilot remains an immutable development control.
gpu_assignment: Atomic blocks of study/repeat/model contain all three policies on the same GPU. Increment block index in study/repeat/model order, assign index mod 2. Record assignment before launch.
pointwise_floors: Selected positive floors in margin-benefit only; disabled in raw/legacy controls
full_prompt_IDs_and_hashes: Every actual business/qualification request, plus separately excluded infrastructure controls
performance_boundary: Actual controller, planning, business, logging/scoring and synchronous verification waits; same two-request wave barrier; no offline cost subtraction. Audit flush time reported separately for every policy.
quality_reporting: Retain all raw/fallback/compiled scores and ID divergences; >0.03 material drops reported in all and compiled denominators, no after-output route relabeling
uncertainty: Readiness bootstrap resamples two-source wave cohorts for cold sessions, because both requests share the wave barrier, and source templates with all ten tenants for fanout; paired fresh repeats are resampled jointly. Whole wall uses paired three-run min/max. Turns/tenants and same-wave sources stay clustered.
p99_uncertainty: 2000 paired cluster/repeat bootstrap draws, seed10672129, with the same cold wave-cohort and fanout template units above; reported vs raw and directly vs legacy. Weighted order statistics checked against literal resampling. Only compute after all cells complete; do not claim significance from point estimates alone.
